episodes.title: Émilie
episodes.summary: As a woman recounts her memories of the attack at the Bataclan, which killed her boyfriend, detectives become convinced that she's hiding something.

episodes.title: Caroline
episodes.summary: After a casualty at a building site, the team interrogates a construction executive who seems to know more about the victim than she's letting on.

episodes.title: Jérôme
episodes.summary: Summoned to work before dawn, the team questions a sales manager suspected of a violent hate crime. Audrey makes a bid to win her colleagues' trust.
